info.name: VATI Microfinance API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the VATI Microfinance Laravel API.

Quick start:
1. Set `base_url`, `admin_email`, and `admin_password` in collection variables.
2. Run **Authentication / Login**. The Bearer token is saved automatically.
3. Run requests in folder order to create organization, member, product, application, loan, and payment data.
4. Requests prefixed with `[Destructive]` should normally be run manually and last.

The collection automatically stores IDs returned by create/approve/payment requests. Validation errors use HTTP 422; unauthenticated requests use HTTP 401.

exec: pm.test('Response is not a server error', function () {

item.name: Flutter Mobile API
item.description: Credit-review, aggregate detail, role dashboard, portfolio, notifications, document evidence, PDF export, member photo, and password-recovery endpoints. Monetary fields in analytics/detail responses are decimal strings. Branch scoping and role permissions are enforced server-side.

request.description: Assigns an active credit officer from the application branch.
Credit-stage recommendation only. It never creates a loan; an authorized administrator performs the final decision. Duplicate submissions return HTTP 409.
Returns one Flutter-ready aggregate: applicant, group metrics, affordability, documents, credit review, deterministic risk signals, and audit history.
Response blocks are role-aware. Credit officers receive queues/targets; administrators receive approval and portfolio metrics.
Always returns a neutral success response to prevent account enumeration.
Consumes a single-use reset token and revokes the user's existing API tokens.
Authenticates a user and saves the Sanctum Bearer token to the collection.

item.name: Onboarding (run after organization and product setup)
item.description: Transactional onboarding APIs. First create the organization branch and a loan product in their respective folders. Then run Group Onboarding, Member Onboarding, and Loan Application Onboarding in that order. Successful responses save `group_id`, `member_id`, and `loan_application_id` for subsequent requests.

request.description: Creates an active lending group. The group code is generated automatically. Required: `branch_id`, `group_name`, `meeting_day`, and `location`. `loan_officer_id`, when supplied, must identify an active user assigned to the same branch. Requires the `create-groups` permission. Returns HTTP 201.

Atomically registers a member in an active group, generates the VATI membership number, creates KYC, records the active membership history, and saves optional nominees. Required: `branch_id`, `group_id`, first/last name, and unique phone. The group must be active and belong to the branch. If `nominees` is supplied, allocations must total exactly 100%. Requires the `create-members` permission. Returns HTTP 201; validation failures return HTTP 422.

request.description: Creates a complete draft loan application in one transaction. The API derives branch and group from the member, verifies that the member/group/product are active, prevents a second open application, calculates affordability figures, and records every use-of-funds allocation. Required: member, product, application type, amount, duration, purpose, business summary, assessment, and utilization lines. Utilization allocations must total the requested amount. A member with no current loan uses `main`; a member with a pending, active, or overdue loan must use `refinance` or `top_up`. For those types provide `existing_loan_balance`, plus a positive `refinancing_amount` or `increment_amount` respectively. Requires `create-loan-applications`. Returns HTTP 201 and saves `loan_application_id`.
